text: Chapter 14: Mainland Toram@Crisis in the Sky
While flying over the mainland of Toram on the ark,\nyou stumbled upon a bunch of flying Coenubias.\nJoin forces with everyone to get rid of them!
You thought it was safe after you beat the flying Coenubias,\nbut a gigantic Coenubia showed up. Defeat Mulgoon's Hand and\nmake sure the ark is safe!
